## Current focus

1.2.0 close-up workshop (`Immersive_Brewing_Cinematic_Hands_On_Overhaul_Handoff.md`) on top of the hands-on workshop
(`Immersive_Brewing_Hands_On_Overhaul_Handoff.md`): feature map, automated checks, real-input journeys and footage are
in `docs/reports/1.2.0-close-up-workshop.md`; human playtests, two real clients under latency, shader/camera-mod
combinations, audio listening and native-language review remain.

## Hands-on workshop map (1.2)

- `workshop/`: pure domain. `KettleProcess` (stages, portions, families, finalization), `MortarProcess` (zones, fines,
  clumping, work budget), `AlembicProcess` (cuts, coolant, routing), `FinishingProcess`, `ReactionFamily`,
  `ToolTrack` (bounded strokes), `Leases`, `WorkshopParts`/`WorkshopGeometry` (part volumes per facing),
  `WorkshopProfile(s)` (datapack `workshop_profiles` and fallbacks), `WorkshopPractice` (server practice setups).
- `interaction/`: `WorkshopPresence` (working views, fake players included), `WorkshopIntents` (validation and budgets),
  `RackWorkshop`.
- Stations: `StationBlockEntity.workshopTick` is the single tick owner (grace seal, snapshots, visuals);
  `act(...)` per station; `directInsert` for right-click loading; schema-3 ledgers (`JobLedger.process`).
- Client: `client/workshop/` (`WorkshopScreen`, `ClientWorkshop` hand/camera, `WorkshopTargets`, `WorkshopKeys`,
  `WorkshopTutorial`, `PracticeBench`); renderers draw from snapshots via `WorkshopRenderBits`.
- Packets: `WorkshopIntentC2S` (epoch, sequence, flags ACK/DEEP/SETUP, expected revision), `WorkshopAckS2C`,
  `WorkshopFocusS2C` (with the view epoch), `WorkshopSnapshotS2C`, `OpenPracticeS2C`; protocol 6.
- Tests: `src/testShared/.../testing/` tenders (`KettleTender`, `MortarTender`, `AlembicTender`, `WorkshopHand`) and
  `LegacyBatches` (1.1-format fixtures); smoke driver `src/smokeTest/.../WorkshopDriver`; real-input journeys
  `RealInput`/`RealJourney`/`ObserverBrewer`/`Footage` (`-Pvariant=journey`).

## Close-up workshop map (1.2.0)

- Camera (client): `client/workshop/WorkshopCamera` (lifecycle, obstruction, glide), `WorkshopProjector` (matrices of
  the drawn frame for picking), `mixin/CameraMixin` (`Camera.setup` tail, MIT notice
  `META-INF/licenses/Diegesis-MIT.txt`); shared fit maths `workshop/CameraFit` and authored shots `workshop/WorkshopShots`.
- Direct setup (server): `blockentity/KettleSetupService` (preview, pages, ghosts, pins, revision); accepted through
  `BrewersKettleBlockEntity.acceptSetup` and the shared `setOut` transaction; `recipe/CatalogSearch.select` pins a page.
- Transfers: carry leases and poses in `BrewersKettleBlockEntity` (`carry`, paced pour/fill queues); client
  `WorkshopTransfers` (lift/travel/align/tip/flow/return/settle, observers from snapshots).
- Presentation (client): `client/presentation/PresentationProfiles` (resource-pack profiles and the reagent table under
  `assets/<ns>/immersive_brewing/presentation/`), `KettleSurface` (liquid height field), `ToolMotion`;
  `client/render/ApparatusBits` (glass, bottles, ghosts, arm, page text).
- Guidance and input: `WorkshopGuidance` (MINIMAL/GUIDED/DETAILED), `WorkshopKeys` (`V` posture, `Z` inspect, `H` help),
  `WorkshopScreen.partAt` (what the cursor would pick), `interaction/StationOffsets` (neighbour switching).
- Process: `KettleProcess` version 2 (posture through `ToolTrack.depth` and `ReactionFamily.mixRate`), version 1 rules
  and wording kept for older payloads.

## Decisions

- 1.2: new work is hands-on at the apparatus; the 1.1 minigame sessions only finish batches saved by 1.1
  (`LEGACY_RESUME`). Brewing owns a local part-volume substitute for Diegesis (ADR-5).
- 1.2.0 close-up: Brewing owns its camera layer; Diegesis 1.0.0-beta.8 is published but not adopted (a second scene and
  authority engine, a beta hard dependency); its camera hook is adapted under MIT (ADR-6). `cameraStyle` AUTO keeps a
  legacy `cameraMode = DIRECT` at the eyes. The Kettle's spout pipe sits forward and low so the dose cups and the
  tray's first row are visible past it (found by the real-input journey: the cups were not pickable).
- 1.2: station lifecycle updates are owed and flushed from the station tick, never sent while building an update
  packet: a re-entrant `sendBlockUpdated` inside the chunk broadcast stranded the section's change set and later block
  changes in that section stopped reaching clients (`WorkshopRegressionGameTests.buildingAnUpdatePacketNeverMarksTheChunk`).

- Quality never edits canonical potion contents; it lives in the `immersive_brewing` stack compound and is resolved
  where effects apply (five verified mixins, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` ADR-1).
- One logical step per server tick (50 ms); clients send input frames only (ADR-2).
- Every material has one owner: job ledgers move reserved stacks out of public slots; breaking packages the ledger
  whole, even during the count-in (ADR-3).
- Plans are validated against the brewing registry through adapters; data can describe, never invent, a transformation.
- Sister mods are optional and isolated: Smithing via IMC + conditioned data, Tanning data only, Enchanting and Jewelry
  coexistence only.
- Version strings live only in `gradle.properties` (mods.toml ranges are expanded from it).
- The help overlay pauses every game, practice included (playtest feedback): the client stops stepping and sends
  `PauseSessionC2S`; the server stops the session clock when it arrives. The resume carries the client's next step
  and remaining count-in, and the server re-anchors `runStartTick` from those (`SessionManager.RESUME_SLACK`), never
  from arrival times: anchoring on arrival times let a pause handled late start the run early and drop frames as
  late (smoke test: mortar extraction 63 instead of 100, back to 100 after). Closing the help mid-run counts in
  `ClientSession.RESUME_TICKS` on the client before the resume is sent. Protocol version 2.
- The Kettle's draft steps with `W`/`S` (`DRAFT_UP`/`DRAFT_DOWN`) instead of absolute `1`/`2`/`3` keys, like the
  Alembic's valves (playtest: too many keys at once); the screen shows each key on the level it selects next.
- Apothecary, More Potions, PotionsMaster and RPG Potions are data only: `compat/<modid>/` plans, reagent profiles,
  effect policies and Alembic recipes behind `forge:mod_loaded` (definition files take Forge conditions), generated by
  `tools/generate_data.py`; jars in `libs/` are compile-only, dev runtime with `-PwithX` or `-PwithPotionMods`.
- The Forge adapter refuses loose registry matches (`RegistryQuery`): a plain `BrewingRecipe` brews only the potion its
  declared input names, though a stand accepts any potion of that container (RPG Potions).
- The Kettle completes its bounded catalog (512 plans per input) with the paths its tray can pay for
  (`PlanIndex.plansUsing`, same bound); the Notebook lists only client-validated paths.

## Known issues

- First-person drinking animation follows the item's own 32 ticks even when quality changes the use time (cosmetic).
- Effect-quality handlers are consulted on drink and splash paths only; other mods' items stay metadata-only in
  lingering clouds and on arrows (API v1 limitation, documented).
- Apothecary's plans follow its config defaults: a changed ingredient leaves that plan unsupported (the new step is a
  contextual query). With More Potions too, a magma block on Awkward is Fire, so Apothecary's Burning plan is
  unsupported (a stand behaves the same). Its six recipes that need Iron's Spellbooks (Mana Regeneration and Mana
  Exhaustion) have no plans.
- Under a tiling window manager the client smoke test needs `tools/run_smoke_matrix.sh` to size its window; a plain
  `runClient -PsmokeTest` uses whatever size the compositor gives.
